verdict.line: You lose the lane in the levels before 6, when Gwen's Q cone and A Thousand Cuts win trades and fund solo kills; you win the game once your wall, mist marks, and Maiden let you split-push past her from level 14 on.

brief.thesis: Gwen's passive (A Thousand Cuts) adds bonus magic damage scaled off your current health and heals her for a share of it, and her Q (Snip Snip!) hits up to six times in a cone with true damage in the center — together they let her outtrade you before your Q (Last Rites) heal and walker swarm come online. Her W (Hallowed Mist) also makes her untargetable to anyone outside the mist, which blunts your W (Dark Procession) wall as a kill tool since she can just bubble up inside it. The 42.7% head-to-head win rate over 634 games and Gwen's solo-kill edge both point the same way: survive lane, don't force it, and win through split-push scaling instead.

theirWindow.what: Once Skip 'n Slash lands she gets bonus attack speed, range, and magic on-hit, and the hit partially refunds the dash's cooldown. Her Q six-hit cone plus passive true damage can burn half your bar in that window before your own Q heal can answer — disengage rather than trade autos.

yourWindow.when: When her W (Hallowed Mist) is down
yourWindow.what: With no mist to hide in and no fresh dash, land your E (Mourning Mist) to mark her and the armor shred actually sticks. Follow with Q (Last Rites)-empowered autos; this is the only window where an all-in or a forced trade actually favors you.

start.why: 48.1% win rate over 287 games — the magic resist sustains you through her Q chip and passive true damage better than Doran's Shield does against a magic-damage laner.

boots.why: 51.5% win rate over 388 games; the magic resist and tenacity blunt both her auto-attack passive and the slow from her R (Needlework).

core.why: Backbone of every high-performing build path in the data; the stat stick lets you finally win extended trades instead of losing them.
Cooldown reduction compounds your Q resets and E marks so you can keep pace with her faster ability rotation.
Highest measured win rate of the Trinity Force follow-ups at 58.8% over 17 games — the shield and tenacity answer her burst windows directly.

situational.when: she or her team stacks armor against your auto-reset pattern
the game has gone long and your wincon is pushing a side lane alone
you need the extra shred and move speed to stick on her between dashes
you can snowball an early all-in during one of her ability-down windows

runes.keystoneWhy: Her passive and Q cone chip you on every trade; Grasp's proc heals you back off the wave itself and punishes her for standing in minion range to poke, which matches the lane's defensive shape.

summoners.why: Teleport lets you reset after losing the early trades and head straight to a side lane to push with your wall and walker swarm once you've out-scaled her dueling power; Flash is your only real answer to being caught by her E (Skip 'n Slash) dash when she commits to an all-in.

playing.title: Trade through the wave, not face-to-face
playing.detail: Her Q hits in a cone and also deals true damage to units in the center while healing her off champion hits — fight near minions so the cone has to split and you aren't the only thing it can hit.

playing.title: Don't wall-combo expecting a kill
playing.detail: W (Dark Procession) can't trap her for a kill if her W (Hallowed Mist) is up, since the mist makes her untargetable from outside it regardless of your wall; use your wall to zone the wave or block a gank path instead.

playing.title: All-in only when her E and W are both down
playing.detail: Her E (Skip 'n Slash, 13-11s cooldown) and W (Hallowed Mist, 22-18s cooldown) are her entire kill and escape kit — commit your own E-into-Q combo only when both are on cooldown.

playing.title: Farm safe before level 6
playing.detail: The data's solo-kill edge is hers; use Q (Last Rites)'s heal to hold CS under tower pressure rather than contesting trades you can't win yet.

playing.title: Mark with E to seed walkers
playing.detail: Mourning Mist's slow and armor shred make graves easier to dig with Q; stacking Mist Walkers early compounds your wave clear and sets up the split-push wincon this matchup is actually won on.

playing.title: Hold R for Maiden's splitpush value, not a duel
playing.detail: Eulogy of the Isles has a 160s first cooldown and doesn't swing a 1v1 immediately — use it to raise walkers off dead minions/champions and snowball side-lane pressure instead of expecting it to win a fight on its own.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the trade windows, power curve, and tactical reasoning are my own read of the ability interactions, not measured data.
